HediffDef.label: kill Thirst
HediffDef.description: This individual has a genetically-induced psychological dependency on killing. Without regular killing in close combat, their psychological state will begin to unravel.\n\nTakes effect after age: 13.

HediffDef.label: gravity sensitivity
HediffDef.description: This individual has a genetic sensitivity to gravity that is currently affecting them, causing strain on their muscles and bones. It is impossible to be comfortable in this state.
